mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated unemployment (UNRATE > 8.0%) signals a recessionary trough where market pessimism is fully priced in, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as recovery expectations build.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high unemployment (UNRATE > 8.0%) and declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signal a deep economic contraction where equity valuations are severely depressed, triggering a rebound in S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0 and INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a recessionary regime, rising housing starts (HOUST > 500) signal improving consumer confidence and economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 500 during a recession, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Falling industrial production (INDPRO < 100) indicates a severe economic slowdown where equity valuations are discounted to the worst-case scenario, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the market anticipates a policy response.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining retail sales (RSAFS < 320000) signal a deepening recession where market pessimism is extreme, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in a policy response.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS < 320000, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of near-zero interest rates (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 8.0%) signals a coordinated monetary and fiscal policy response to a severe recession, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.5% and UNRATE > 8.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a recession, a sustained decline in consumer spending (RSAFS < 320000 for two consecutive months) signals a market bottom where the worst is priced in, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the economy recovers.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS < 320000 for two consecutive months during a recession, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.
